settings.heading: Size Guide
settings.text: Every category in the shop runs XS–3X. Grab a soft tape measure (or a string and a ruler), take three numbers, and match them below. When a brand runs small or generous, we note it right on the product page.

settings.title: Bust
settings.text: Around the fullest part, tape level and snug but not tight. Wear the bra you'd wear with the piece.

settings.title: Waist
settings.text: Around your natural waist — the narrowest point, usually just above the belly button. Relax; don't suck in.

settings.title: Hips
settings.text: Around the fullest part of your hips and seat, feet together. For swim, this is the number that matters most.

settings.heading: Find your fit
settings.intro: Measurements are in inches and reflect body size, not garment size. Boutique brands run a little differently from each other — between sizes? Size up for woven fabrics (linen, chiffon, denim without stretch), down for stretch knits.
settings.footnote: Not sure? Message us a photo of the tag and your usual size — we'll tell you straight.

settings.heading: Swimsuits: how should they fit?
settings.row_content: Snug in the store — swim fabric relaxes about half a size once wet. Straps should sit flat without digging; a bottom that rides up a touch dry will settle in the water.

settings.heading: Gowns and dresses: what about length?
settings.row_content: Our gowns are cut for a 5'5" wearer in a 2–3" heel. Bring or tell us your shoe height and we'll point you to the styles that won't need a hem — or recommend our local tailor.

settings.heading: Do you carry plus sizes in every category?
settings.row_content: Yes. XS–3X isn't a corner of the store — it's every rack: swim, dresses, gowns, tops, bottoms. If your size is out online, ask; we can often get it in.
